name: Greentown
verdict: Greentown China's single largest shareholder is the wholly state-owned China Communications Construction Group (CCCG) with approximately 28.88%; China has a documented record of serious abuses in Xinjiang.
note: Back-of-shirt sponsor ('绿城 GREENTOWN') and naming sponsor of Zhejiang FC ('浙江俱乐部绿城队') for the 2026 Chinese Super League season (Greentown Football Archives kit-ad table; Qianjiang Evening News, Feb 2025; club announcement via Dongqiudi, 8 March 2026). Rating note: proposed 'concern' — wholly state-owned CCCG is Greentown China's single largest shareholder with ~28.88% (5%+, no majority; the board chairmanship went to a CCCG official in March 2025 per Tencent/中房网, which a maintainer may weigh), and the UN OHCHR Xinjiang assessment plus Human Rights Watch document serious abuses by that state. ON HOLD: a proposed rating resting on state ownership with a documented record awaits a maintainer's review (same pattern as saic-motor).

why.text: The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations had been committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. Greentown, Zhejiang FC's naming and back-of-shirt sponsor, is the brand of Greentown China Holdings, whose single largest shareholder is the wholly state-owned China Communications Construction Group (CCCG) with approximately 28.88% of the company.
why.messageLine: Greentown: wholly state-owned CCCG is owner Greentown China's largest shareholder (~28.88%); the UN has documented serious abuses in Xinjiang.
